nodes.name: Pristine MoB2 molten salt synthesis
nodes.procedure: Molten salt technique was employed to synthesize nanosized MoB2 by taking advantage of binary NaCl-KCl eutectic point with an equal molar ratio (Tm ≈ 657°C). A 1:3 weight ratio between the reactants and salts was used during synthesis. The required amount of ingredients were weighed and transferred into a hardened stainless-steel vial under a protective Ar medium inside a glovebox (M Braun Labmaster Pro DP, H2O and O2 < 0.1 ppm). Prior to the thermal treatment, in order to gain a homogeneous mixture and mechanical activation, the ball milling (Spex SamplePrep 8000D Mixer/Mill) process was performed at 1200 rpm for 10 min by exploiting four hardened steel balls (1/4″ in diameter). The resulting powder mixture was transferred into an alumina crucible and then put into a quartz glass tube to apply a heat treatment procedure. All the transferring steps were also conducted under a protective Ar environment inside the glovebox. The quartz tube was placed into a vertical furnace and kept at 1173 K for 60 min under constant Ar flow. After the heat treatment step, a natural cooling process was utilized to bring the sample batch to room temperature. To remove the salts, the resulting powder was washed with deionized (DI) water at 373 K. Finally, following the initial rinse, the resulting product was rinsed several times with DI water and absolute ethanol. It was then kept at 353 K for 120 min in a vacuum oven to remove the undesired residual water or ethanol.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns show unsubstituted MoB₂ matches pure α-MoB₂ (PDF 15-10763); Ni/Co substitution causes progressive phase transformation to β-MoB₂ (PDF 15-11521) with increasing TM content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: XRD patterns of parent and metal-substituted MoB₂: (d) Ni-substituted MoB₂ and (e) Co-substituted MoB₂ ... while unsubstituted MoB₂ was purely synthesized in accordance with α-MoB₂ structure, introducing the Co and Ni into the MoB₂ structure imposes an alteration in the crystal structure.

nodes.characterization_summary: FESEM reveals interconnected branched-like nanoparticles (50-100 nm size range) for all catalysts; Ni/Co substitution causes morphological changes with agglomeration at higher substitution levels.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From these images, the presence of interconnected branched-like nanoparticles with a size distribution range of 50 - 100 nm is evident.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS confirms uniform elemental distribution of Mo, Ni/Co, B across catalyst surfaces with surface oxygen detection.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDS elemental analysis of parent MoB₂, Mo₀.₉Ni₀.₁B₂, and Mo₀.₈Co₀.₂B₂ samples ... showing the uniform distribution of the elements.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo₀.₉Ni₀.₁B₂ and Mo₀.₈Co₀.₂B₂ show nanosized subgrains (~10 nm) with lattice fringes of 0.262 nm and 0.266 nm corresponding to (100) P6/mmm or (101) R3m planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HR-TEM images reveal the nanosized subgrains around 10 nm ... The well-resolved lattice fringes with interplanar spacings of 0.262 and 0.266 nm ... correspond to the (100) plane for P6/mmm or (101) plane for R3m.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution XPS of Mo₀.₉Ni₀.₁B₂: Mo 3d Mo-B (228.78/231.88 eV), Ni 2p Ni-B (853.78/870.98 eV); Mo₀.₈Co₀.₂B₂ shows higher surface oxidation with Co 2p Co-B (779.08/793.78 eV) and prominent Co-O peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Parts f and g of Figure 2 also demonstrate the high-resolution XPS spectra of Mo 3d, B 1s, Ni 2p, Co 2p, and O 1s for these samples. The first doublet located at binding energies (BEs) of 228.78 and 231.88 eV corresponds to the Mo-B bond of MoB₂.

nodes.characterization_summary: BET surface areas: MoB₂ (15.74 m²/g), Mo₀.₉Ni₀.₁B₂ (15.97), Mo₀.₈Ni₀.₂B₂ (14.24), Mo₀.₆Ni₀.₄B₂ (9.86), Mo₀.₉Co₀.₁B₂ (16.63), Mo₀.₈Co₀.₂B₂ (14.79), Mo₀.₆Co₀.₄B₂ (11.76 m²/g); negative correlation with substitution content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The BET surface area of the parent MoB₂ along with Mo₀.₉Ni₀.₁B₂, Mo₀.₈Ni₀.₂B₂, Mo₀.₆Ni₀.₄B₂, Mo₀.₉Co₀.₁B₂, Mo₀.₈Co₀.₂B₂, and Mo₀.₆Co₀.₄B₂ were determined ... While parent MoB₂ disclosed a BET surface area of 15.74 m²/g ...

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED confirms polycrystalline ring patterns for Mo₀.₉Ni₀.₁B₂ (P6/mmm) and Mo₀.₈Co₀.₂B₂ (R3m), consistent with powder XRD results.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SAED images evidently certified the ring-composed structure of Mo₀.₉Ni₀.₁B₂ and Mo₀.₈Co₀.₂B₂, confirming their polycrystalline nature. The SAED images can be indexed to the P6/mmm and R3m structures equally well which are consistent with the powder XRD results.
